preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between n-1 and the maximum possible number of edges in a simple graph with n nodes inclusive.
The starting city s is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, w in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities u and v, both between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in roads)
preconditions.description: The length of each road w is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The maximum number of unhappy friends is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.
